title: NDA-backed candidates lead in first phase of panchayat polls in three districts of Andhra Pradesh

ai.summary: The first phase of Gram Panchayat elections in three Andhra Pradesh districts saw TDP-backed candidates win most seats, with high turnout and some tensions at polling stations.

facts.claim: The first phase of Gram Panchayat elections in Chittoor, Annamayya and Sri Sathya Sai districts witnessed brisk polling on Thursday, followed by counting of votes from 2 p.m.
facts.quote: The first phase of Gram Panchayat elections in Chittoor, Annamayya and Sri Sathya Sai districts witnessed brisk polling on Thursday, followed by counting of votes from 2 p.m.

facts.claim: In Annamayya district, 72 TDP-backed candidates and two YSRCP-backed candidates had won
facts.quote: According to reports available by 6 p.m., as many as 72 TDP-backed candidates and two YSRCP-backed candidates had won in Annamayya district.

facts.claim: In Chittoor, six TDP-backed candidates were declared elected, while two TDP-backed candidates registered victories in Sri Sathya Sai district
facts.quote: In Chittoor, six TDP-backed candidates were declared elected, while two TDP-backed candidates registered victories in Sri Sathya Sai district.

facts.claim: Turnout was brisk from the morning at most polling centres. By 11 a.m., Sri Sathya Sai district recorded 67.70% polling, followed by Annamayya with over 65% and Chittoor with 60.05%.
facts.quote: Turnout was brisk from the morning at most polling centres. By 11 a.m., Sri Sathya Sai district recorded 67.70% polling, followed by Annamayya with over 65% and Chittoor with 60.05%.

facts.claim: In Annamayya district, tension occurred at polling locations where YSRCP-backed polling agents and leaders staged protests, alleging they were denied entry into polling stations
facts.quote: At Sambepalle mandal headquarters and Routhukunta, YSRCP-backed polling agents and leaders reportedly staged protests, alleging that they were being denied entry into polling stations.

facts.claim: In Sri Sathya Sai district, tension prevailed at Kanaganapalle panchayat for nearly two hours. TDP supporters alleged that the police resorted to a lathi-charge when they tried to prevent a group of YSRCP cadres from entering a polling booth
facts.quote: In Sri Sathya Sai district, tension prevailed at Kanaganapalle panchayat for nearly two hours. TDP supporters alleged that the police resorted to a lathi-charge when they tried to prevent a group of YSRCP cadres from entering a polling booth.
